timing_scope: Timed evaluation path includes FullCloud file load/normalization/hash voxel grouping, per-pass tensor preparation/upload, warm model forward and download/merge. Excludes one unmeasured warm-up forward per method per scene, checkpoint load, integrity hashing, prediction compression, reporting and shared final metric computation. It is not process-launch-to-finished-artifact elapsed time. No raw point is omitted. Methods receive identical data; no training is performed.
warmup_policy: Before timing the first voxel pass of each scene, each of the three methods executes one full warm-up forward. These warm-ups affect cache state but are not attributed to individual method timings. Their costs cannot be reconstructed separately from the combined scene wall time. No numerical timing record is changed by this scope disclosure.
statistics: Physical-space cluster bootstrap, 10000 samples: ScanNet sceneXXXX groups every scan suffix; S3DIS room is the unit. The primary point estimate remains the registered per-scan geometric mean, with its cluster-weighted bootstrap interval. Equal-physical-space geometric mean is secondary. scene_cluster95 is a backward-compatible alias of physical_space_cluster95. Repeated voxel passes are not independent units. Partial summaries are monitoring only, not final full-split claims.
